question: P and Q start from the same point and at the same time with speeds 20 km/hr and 16 km/hr respectively. What is the distance between P and Q after 4 hours if both move in same direction?
solution:
Given:

P and Q start from the same point and at the same time with speeds 20 km/hr and 16 km/hr respectively

Concept used:

The Relative speed in the same direction is = Greater speed - Smaller speed 

Distance = speed × time 

Calculation:

The Relative speed in the same direction is ,

⇒ (20 -16) km/hr = 4km / hr

So distance travelled in 4 hr is,

⇒ 4 × 4 = 16 km

∴ The correct option is 4
